edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. It governs your forward steps. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s maxed — 2 seconds untargetable that breaks the Nether Grasp channel, so bait it or press R while it is down. - Transfusion is 9s at rank 1. - Tides of Blood costs him health every cast: chip him through it.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling out of Nether Grasp, healing your chip back, and outscaling you into a durable teamfighter.

edits.before: Carry by subtraction — every fight starts 4v5 when your R lands; your job is the wave control that makes the fight happen on your timer.
edits.after: Carry by patience — Nether Grasp only sticks once Sanguine Pool is spent; make the fight happen inside the 16 to 28 seconds it is down.

edits.before: You are a suppression delivery system: shield up, hold a flank, and Grasp their carry the moment the fight breathes. The visions and burn do the rest.
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds before your second item — Transfusion and Hemoplague heal through everything else. Then flank and Grasp their carry once his pool is spent.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Visions on a caster plus Voidlings crash every wave while his 13-second E costs him health — perma-push and make him choose between farming and healing.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Stepping up without Void Shift lets his Q heal through your chip for free — walk in only with the shield charged and his pool on cooldown.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crashed wave into a map play. Ignite is the real pick here: Grievous Wounds cuts Transfusion and Hemoplague healing in lane.

edits.before: The matchup evens out at two-plus items. Vladimir scales into a durable teamfighter, his sustain lets him survive your poke, and a well-timed Sanguine Pool can cleanse your R mid-channel, negating your one guaranteed lockdown. Late-game becomes a timing duel — bait his W before you suppress, and rely on the lead you built early rather than expecting to win a farmed Vlad in a straight fight.
edits.after: The matchup evens out at two-plus items. Vladimir scales into a durable teamfighter, Transfusion and Hemoplague heal through your chip unless you carry Grievous Wounds, and 2 seconds of untargetable pool break your R mid-channel. Late-game is a timing duel — bait the 16-second W before you suppress, and lean on the lead you built early rather than a straight fight.
